author: gpt-5.6-luna
brief: Phase: design review. Role of the person asking: reviewer. Packet kind: a design for delivering order events to partner companies by webhook from a multi-tenant platform. Context: partner tiers and contracts, the current auth service, the data classification policy (which fields are personal data), traffic numbers, a past incident where a partner endpoint was taken over. Plant: partners register any URL, including internal addresses, so the sender can be pointed at internal services; the signature covers the body but not a timestamp, so captured messages can be replayed; one shared signing secret is used for all partners; payloads include personal data fields the classification policy says partners must not get; there is no way to rotate a partner secret without downtime; the retry queue is shared across tenants so one slow partner delays everyone; delivery logs store full payloads for a year against the retention rule. Write every planted problem the way the team really wrote them: no comment, diff line, test name or doc may say decoy, planted, intentional, on purpose or correct here. Context files give facts and numbers only, never a conclusion: an incident summary says what happened and when, and must not name a lesson that restates a planted problem; no context file may say what this design gets wrong.
